_comment: Per-cart manifest for the bundled Tempest homage, picked up from the <cart>.voxbox.json sidecar convention.
name: tempest (bundled)
controls: shoot spikes down before the dive between levels
flippers that reach the rim will come along it for you
_camera: Straight down the tube's axis, unlike every other bundled cart. The camera sits well outside the volume at y=200 looking at the far wall, which puts the near rim 84 voxels away and the far rim 194 — a 2.3x perspective ratio. The web is tapered to 0.42 on top of that, so the far mouth ends up about a fifth the size of the near rim and the tunnel reads as long. fov 56 is the narrowest that still clears the near rim's corners: at 84 voxels the horizontal half-extent is 59 and the rim needs 48.
_groundZ: Off. There is no ground in a tube, and the auto-derivation would otherwise find the mode of the topmost voxels somewhere on the tube's lower wall and hang drop shadows across the web.
_persistGlobals: None needed: the hiscore goes through cartdata/dget/dset.
